responsibility: Defines the operand predicates used by the M32C machine descriptions to classify registers, control registers, memory forms, immediates, address registers, shift counts, return operands, and legal subregs. These predicates encapsulate backend-specific operand legality beyond generic GCC predicates, including exclusions for wide subregs, special register subsets, memreg and address-register classes, and helpers that align recog/reload with the port’s unusual register and addressing model.
